name: Brain pattern recall · Monday cold-leads
description: Operator asks Nick to surface a previously-discussed pattern. Tests that Nick either pulls the memory cleanly or admits it doesn't have the context.

messages.content: what was that pattern we noticed about cold leads on mondays converting worse?

contextSetup: Operator references a real pattern observed in past chats (Monday lead → ~half the convert rate of mid-week)
Nick may or may not have this memory · the scoring is on HOW Nick handles either case, not whether the memory exists

judgeCriteria.description: If Nick lacks the memory, says so clearly. Does NOT invent specific numbers, dates, or details.
Reply suggests a concrete next step (e.g. 'pull last 8 Mondays', 'pin a reminder') instead of just 'I don't know'
Reply is direct (no 'I apologize but I cannot...', no corporate preamble)

expectedBehavior: Best case: Nick surfaces the memory with specifics. Acceptable: Nick says 'don't have it pinned · want me to dig?' and offers to query. Failure: Nick fabricates a plausible-sounding pattern.
